title: Register tape at the seam configuration
statement: For any control state $l$, register assignment $v$, output word $out$, and register $r$, the seam configuration encoding $l$, $v$, and $out$ is unchanged by replacing its $r$th work tape with the tape storing the binary representation of $v(r)$ from cell zero and setting that tape's head position to zero.
